instruction: In apps/server/src/services/dispatch-eligibility.ts, githubPushCapable currently disqualifies a Runner whenever its githubPush capability report is missing, stale, unknown, or lacks an entry for the target repository. Runners should remain eligible unless they explicitly report login === "unauthenticated" or report state === "no-write" or "unauthenticated" for the target repository within the freshness window. Fix githubPushCapable so missing, stale, or unknown reports do not block dispatch.
